items.summary: Péter Magyar and his victorious Tisza party have wasted no time preparing for the transfer of power in Hungary after their dramatic landslide defeat of Viktor Orbán last Sunday.

items.summary_zh: 乌克兰官员说,星期六有人在基辅开火,至少6人被炸死,另有人受伤。

items.title: HiPP recalls jarred baby food in Austria over contamination fears

items.title: What next for South African opposition firebrand Malema after his five-year prison sentence?
items.title_zh: 南非反对派Firebrand Malema被判五年后,
items.summary: The leader of one of South Africa's main opposition parties, Julius Malema, has been given a five-year prison term for unlawfully possessing a firearm and firing it in public, casting a huge question mark over his political career.
items.summary_zh: 南非主要反对党之一的领袖Julius Malema因非法持有火器并公开射击而被判处五年监禁,为他的政治生涯留下了巨大的疑问。

items.title: What we know about the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire
items.title_zh: 我们对以黎停火的了解
items.summary: US President Donald Trump announced on Thursday that the leaders of Israel and Lebanon have agreed to a 10-day ceasefire, which took effect from 17:00 EST (21:00 GMT; midnight local time) on 16 April.
items.summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普星期四宣布,以色列和黎巴嫩两国领导人已同意10天停火,停火自4月16日17:00(格林尼治平时21:00;当地时间午夜)起生效.

items.title: Ceasefire with Israel brings respite to Lebanon, but obstacles to peace remain
items.title_zh: 与以色列的停火给黎巴嫩带来了缓冲,但和平的障碍依然存在
items.summary: At the stroke of midnight, gunfire and fireworks celebrated the start of the ceasefire in Beirut.
items.summary_zh: 在午夜中,枪炮和烟花在贝鲁特庆祝停火的开始。

items.summary_zh: 总统唐纳德·特朗普表示,美国和伊朗结束战争的谈判可以在本周末尽早恢复,华盛顿和德黑兰"非常接近"达成协议.
